subject: Re: Tracking and telemetry evidence request for NA marketing audit
messages:
From: Carolyn Li <carolyn.li@brightads.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: David Nguyen <d.nguyen@brightads.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tracking and telemetry evidence — upcoming NA marketing audit

Hi Mina,

We have an upcoming privacy audit for our North America marketing stack next month. The audit team asked us to collect vendor evidence around: which cookies/tracking pixels your SDKs set from first- and third-party contexts, where telemetry (error logs, usage metrics) is transmitted (regions), and what subprocessors/process flows are involved for marketing analytics.

Could you please provide: 1) a short mapping of cookie names and purpose (first vs third party), 2) network egress regions for telemetry and any EU/US transfer mechanisms you use, and 3) a copy of your current subprocessor inventory and DPA (if there is a newer version). A consolidated packet would be ideal — the audit deadline is Oct 18.

Thanks — Carolyn
Carolyn Li
Security & Privacy Program Manager, BrightAds
carolyn.li@brightads.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Carolyn Li <carolyn.li@brightads.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tracking and telemetry evidence — upcoming NA marketing audit

Hi Carolyn — thanks for the heads up and the list. I can pull together the packet and we have standard artifacts we provide for audits (current DPA, subprocessor inventory, and a telemetry flow diagram). Before I package everything, two quick clarifications: 1) do you need per-region cookie mappings (e.g., EU cookie banner behavior vs. default global tag) or will a global mapping suffice? 2) for telemetry, do you need retention windows and sample logs, or only the egress/region information?

I’ll copy our compliance lead and the NA sales lead to make sure we include the right attachments and expedite signoff. We should be able to send a first draft by Oct 7.

Regards,
Mina Haddad

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Tracking and telemetry evidence — upcoming NA marketing audit

Mina — tagging here. Marissa: can you confirm we can share our redacted sample logs and the telemetry egress regions for BrightAds? They’re in production and we may want to avoid disclosure of specific customer IDs. Suggested approach: 1) send cookie mapping by name/purpose and whether it’s set by client-side SDK or server-side tag, 2) telemetry map that shows destinations (us-west, us-east, eu-west) and whether transfers rely on SCCs/standard contractual clauses, 3) subprocessor CSV and latest DPA PDF.

I’ll authorize the sales credit for turnaround time. If there are any redlines to the DPA, flag before sending.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, North America
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Carolyn Li <carolyn.li@brightads.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 15:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tracking and telemetry evidence — upcoming NA marketing audit

Hi Carolyn — attaching a consolidated packet for your audit team. Attached: DPA-v3.pdf (latest signed template), subprocessor-inventory-2027Q3.csv (columns: vendor_name, purpose, data_types, region), and telemetry-callflow-diagram.png (high-level flow: SDK -> edge gateway -> primary processing region -> archival region).

Summary answers to your questions:
- Cookie/tracking mapping: included in the subprocessor CSV and in the first tab of the CSV. We call out whether a cookie is set by our client-side SDK, by your first-party tag server, or by a partner integration.
- Telemetry egress/regions: primary telemetry is ingested in us-west (Oregon) by default; EU customers may opt to keep telemetry in eu-west (Frankfurt) under dedicated contracts. Any cross-border data transfers from EU to US are executed under SCCs and documented in the DPA.
- Retention and samples: We cannot share raw customer logs; however, we have provided a redacted sample (log schema and a synthetic sample row in the CSV) and retention windows (30 days for ephemeral logs, 13 months for aggregated usage metrics, see DPA section 4.2).

If you need per-country cookie banner behavior, let us know and we’ll include the banner rules and tag-modifier list. Otherwise this packet should cover the audit checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
attachments: [DPA-v3.pdf (application/pdf), subprocessor-inventory-2027Q3.csv (text/csv), telemetry-callflow-diagram.png (image/png)]
